hexstrike-ai.description: HexStrike AI v6.0.1 - Advanced Cybersecurity Automation Platform. Remove --lazy if the server is always running before the AI client starts.

_comment: 1. Replace /absolute/path/to/hexstrike-ai-update with your real checkout path (./install.sh does this automatically).
2. Prefer the venv python: <repo>/hexstrike-env/bin/python instead of system python3.
3. Start the server first: source hexstrike-env/bin/activate && python3 hexstrike_server.py
4. --lazy avoids MCP 'Connection closed' kills when the server is still starting.
5. --health-timeout 15 fixes the old 5s timeout bug on slow machines.
6. For OpenCode, see opencode.json.example (single source of truth: ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json).
